name: What information should I gather before a luxury property valuation?

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather before a luxury property valuation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a luxury property valuation, you should gather detailed information about your property. This includes architectural plans, recent renovation records, a list of high-end appliances or smart home systems, and details of any unique features like custom landscaping, security systems, or energy-efficient upgrades. Providing a history of maintenance and any HOA documents can also be helpful. This preparation allows the valuer to fully understand and account for all value-contributing elements, ensuring a comprehensive assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather architectural plans, renovation records, appliance details, unique feature lists, and maintenance history before a luxury property valuation to ensure a comprehensive assessment.
